page.overview:
Who is Alex Carvill's partner?

A race official at the Porto Corsa Grand Prix is the Alex Carvill's partner in Cars 2.

The guard appears alongside Alex Carvill, inspecting and letting some fans and reporters through to see Lightning McQueen, who won the second World Grand Prix race in Porto Corsa, Italy. He then sees Mater, disguised as Francesco's Fan, coming towards them and telling them that he has to announce McQueen because The Lemons are going to kill him. However, he and Alex didn't believe him because he was a lunatic and tried to keep him from passing, but Mater rushed in, and then Professor Z, Victor Hugo, and the Hugos captured him and gave Ivan permission to take him to London, United Kingdom.
